walk_sequence_zh: 13号线大钟寺站A口方向—地面路径—1733地面/B1/B2—12号线大钟寺站D口—北三环西路桥下
walk_sequence_en: Line 13 Dazhongsi Exit A direction—surface route—1733 ground/B1/B2—Line 12 Dazhongsi Exit D—North Third Ring underpass

method.privacy_processing: Selected frames were re-encoded without EXIF; no raw GPS track, live-photo payload or original video is submitted. People remain incidental and non-identifying at publication scale.
method.limits_zh: 一次傍晚公共视点观察，不是测绘、客流调查、无障碍审计、权属核验或运营访谈；不能外推全天、工作日/周末或长期规律。
method.limits_en: One evening observation from public viewpoints; not a survey, footfall count, accessibility audit, ownership check or operator interview, and not generalisable to daily, weekday/weekend or long-term patterns.

observations.place_en: Surface route near Line 13 Exit A
observations.observed_zh: 高架站体、施工/围挡、台阶与指向12号线的临时导向同时出现；普通方向确认先于任何数字服务。
observations.observed_en: The elevated station, construction enclosure, level changes and temporary direction toward Line 12 coexist; ordinary orientation must precede any digital service.
observations.design_response_zh: 首发单元从实体方向牌、人工问路和无障碍替代核验开始，不把App路径当唯一入口。
observations.design_response_en: The first-use unit begins with physical direction, human help and verification of an accessible alternative, never an app-only route.

observations.place_en: 1733 sunken commercial interface and Line 12 Exit D
observations.observed_zh: D口与1733地面、B1/B2的楼梯、扶梯、商业和景观形成同一多层到达系统，商业活动集中在多层室内与下沉界面。
observations.observed_en: Exit D, stairs, escalators, commerce and landscape across 1733 ground/B1/B2 form one layered arrival system, with commercial activity concentrated in multi-level indoor and sunken interfaces.
observations.design_response_zh: A—1733—D记录为T0时间切片；服务接口须随施工和未来站城整合迁移。
observations.design_response_en: Record A–1733–D as a T0 time slice; the service interface must relocate through construction and future station-city integration.

observations.observed_zh: D口同时连接地面步行、下沉商业与无障碍设施方向；是否已开通跨线站内通道未由本次观察证实。
observations.observed_en: Exit D connects surface walking, sunken commerce and accessibility facilities; this observation did not verify whether an internal cross-line passage is open.
observations.design_response_zh: 把运营状态做成C1现场字段，开放前由轨道运营方复核；概念图不宣称新建或调整出入口。
observations.design_response_en: Make operating status a C1 on-site field verified by the rail operator before opening; the concept does not claim a new or relocated exit.

observations.place_zh: 北三环西路桥下步行与非机动车界面
observations.place_en: Walking–micromobility interface under North Third Ring Road
observations.observed_zh: 桥下遮蔽、公交等候、步行与大量非机动车停放共享有限边缘；冲突类型可见，但本次没有做数量统计。
observations.observed_en: Shelter, bus waiting, walking and substantial micromobility parking share a limited edge; conflict types are visible, but no count was conducted.
observations.design_response_zh: 先做不占盲道和通勤主线的停放/等候边界与维护责任，再讨论任何数字引导或低速设备。
observations.design_response_en: First define parking/waiting edges and maintenance responsibility without occupying tactile paving or the commuting line, before any digital guidance or low-speed device.

commercial_navigation_check.use: background plausibility check of POI identity and short A-to-D walking scale only
